races.verdict: MOTAWAARED certainly wasn't winning out of turn at Ayr on Thursday but he's a consistent and in-form performer, which cannot be said about most of these. races.display_title: Kick Start Your Career With The SRA Selling Stakes
races.verdict: POSSESSIVE didn't kick on after a promising winning debut for Karl Burke but new connections are quick to drop him in grade and he's more than capable of winning on these terms. races.verdict: MACANUDO can extend his good run since blinkered and make it 3 wins in his last 4 starts. Moostar makes obvious appeal off the same mark as when successful over 7f at Leicester last Monday but things may need to drop her way from a wide stall back over shorter, particularly if she's slowly away from the start again. Last month's Windsor second Rory's Royale completes the shortlist. MACANUDO (IRE) MOOSTAR RORY'S ROYALE

races.verdict: Having caught the eye on his penultimate start, EMPEROR CARADOC fully confirmed the promise of that run when getting on top late on over 5f at Redcar 9 days ago. He ought to be highly competitive again on the back of a 4 lb rise with the return to 6f a likely plus. Kats Bob and Fizzy Cristal are others to consider, along with Acclaimed Freedom . EMPEROR CARADOC (FR) KATS BOB FIZZY CRISTAL

races.verdict: ICE SHOW was much improved on the back of an 8-week absence when opening her account over 7f here 10 days ago. races.verdict: ALEX BELARDO can have a line put through his Down Royal effort 14 days ago where he endured a nightmare passage and looks worth chancing now back on his last winning mark and returned to this level. Ella's Gold was caught a bit too far back last time, but ran well at Navan in August and could prove the main danger if reverting to more positive tactics here. Buttermere Ridge kept on when third at Listowel and has a chance if in the same form. ALEX BELARDO (IRE) ELLA'S GOLD (IRE) BUTTERMERE RIDGE (IRE)

races.display_title: Boyle Maiden
races.verdict: TEOEST continues to progress with experience and chased home a subsequent winner at Listowel last time. He meets several of these on much better terms than he would in a handicap and is taken to get off the mark. Saliba should benefit from the step back up in trip and might be the main danger if belatedly building on his Punchestown second, while Big Cypress was unlucky not to win at Gowran and is also firmly in the mix. TEOEST (IRE) SALIBA (IRE) BIG CYPRESS

races.display_title: Roscommon Rated Race
races.verdict: BACK STRAIGHT found listed company too much at Killarney a week ago but had opened his account in a maiden previously and can bounce back returned to a more suitable level. Minella Rockett completed a hat-trick, including a win over hurdles, and remained in top form when narrowly denied at Punchestown last time, so looks the main threat, while God of Power is respected on the pick of his efforts this year despite struggling in handicap company last time.
